05 What I’m thinking about

The interesting part of AI is what happens next.

I share thoughts on practical business AI, healthcare and MedTech, automation, and the decisions that turn experiments into useful products.

    • Agents are most useful when they plug into the ERP, CRM and Power Platform tools teams already use.
    • I design clear approval points, so a person signs off before anything important happens.
    • Start with one workflow, measure it, then expand.
    • At Medioteq I work on AI-driven health intelligence.
    • Clinical settings need trust, privacy and fit with existing systems before they need clever models.
    • The goal is support for clinicians and operations, not replacement.
    • Every architecture decision is also a product and business decision.
    • I translate business goals into technology roadmaps teams can deliver.
    • Good leadership keeps experiments moving toward useful products.
